decisions.reason: The necessary Big Block ticket-recipient change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The necessary Small Block ticket-recipient change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Changing the recipient selected for a no-code commission does not alter the primary-sale allocation amounts or the existing condition that every primary mint funds the commission allocation.

The approved FAQ still says no-code rewards go to a random existing NFT holder, but message 156 explicitly presents its revised wording as About-page content; it is unclear whether the client intended that wording to replace the separately approved FAQ copy.
The About-page referral copy already incorporates the same-message change from a random existing NFT holder to a random existing ticket holder.
The source changes recipient selection only when no referral code is provided; coded-referral commission behavior remains unchanged.
No-code reward allocation does not change how referral codes are derived, retained, or displayed.
Changing the recipient of tickets from no-code mints does not determine or modify how prize winners collect prizes.
Selecting a random existing ticket holder for no-code rewards does not change the state that transfers when an NFT is sold.
The no-code primary-mint recipient change does not alter secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or whether secondary sales generate tickets.
The recipient selected for no-code commissions and tickets does not affect Aave yield generation for prize-pool deposits.
The no-code recipient-selection change does not alter fiat users' dashboard access or wallet requirements for receiving and holding rewards.
